name: Onii-chan Nechatta?
original_name: お兄ちゃん寝ちゃった？
source:
Cute little sister spends all day every day with the brother she adores. They play games, they take baths, at bedtime she cradles his head in her lap.

"Oniichan...... You're asleep, right? Definitely not awake......"

Late at night, she gives him secret kisses and things. But the things have grown more daring... and now little sister has crossed a line.

"I want oniichan's penis inside me..." 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/announce/=/product_id/RE184864.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
可爱的妹妹每天都和崇拜的哥哥待在一起。他们一起玩游戏、一起洗澡；到了睡觉时间，她还会让哥哥枕在自己的腿上。

“哥哥……你睡着了吧？肯定没有醒着……”

深夜，她偷偷亲吻哥哥，做些亲密举动。但这些举动越来越大胆……如今，妹妹已经越过了界线。

“我想让哥哥的阴茎进入我的身体……”
